units.source_text: 樱子双手拿着点燃了火的半椭圆形铁丝圈的两头，

en.t: Sakurako held both ends of a flaming semi-elliptical wire hoop in her two hands,

units.source_text: 在团团转圈的马儿的背上，轻巧地表演着单人跳火绳，

en.t: and on the back of a horse turning round and round, she lightly performed a solo fire-rope jump,

units.source_text: 就像女神镶在火焰画出的椭圆画框里一样，

en.t: as if she were a goddess set inside an oval frame drawn by flames,

units.source_text: 从脚下到头顶罩上一个光圈，艳丽极了。

en.t: with a halo of light covering her from her feet to the top of her head, dazzlingly beautiful.
